run_property_prediction_experiment: run the property prediction experiment on cifar10 or imagenet using a GHN checkpoint
extract_graph_embeddings: extract graph embeddings from neural network architectures using a loaded GHN model
train_svr_regression_model: train an SVR regression model with grid search cross-validation on graph embeddings
evaluate_kendall_tau_correlation: evaluate rank correlation between predicted and actual architecture properties using kendalltau
find_best_architecture: find the best architecture in the search split by predicting a given property
